File Information
Collection: E-Commerce Backend QA
Environment: E-Commerce QA - Challenge
Collection Description
QA suite for the e-commerce API, covering auth, products and orders. RUNNING IT Import this collection along with the environment export, select "E-Commerce QA - Challenge", and hit Run. Nothing needs editing first. The suite registers its own users each run, captures the tokens itself, and reads product ids and prices from the API at runtime rather than hardcoding them, so it survives the data resets mentioned in the brief. ABOUT THE FAILURES 20 assertions fail, and that's deliberate. The tests assert what the spec says should happen rather than what the API currently does, so a red test is a finding rather than a broken test. Those requests are prefixed [BUG] and each points at the matching write-up in BUGS.md. Anything not marked [BUG] passes, so new red means a real regression. A few requests are prefixed [OK-BY-DESIGN]. Those cover behaviour that looks odd at first but that I concluded is intentional, most notably seeded users being blocked from creating orders. They're written as passing tests so nobody has to rediscover the reasoning, and so a change in that policy would still show up. Folders run in order: setup first to create users and grab tokens, then register, login, products, order authorization, order validation, and finally the happy path and totals.
